correctness.rationale: A rank-two monotone map is uniquely a cut plus ordered image pair. Computing both threefold compositions yields the precise mutual-inverse criterion a<=h<b and c<=k<d. Each Θ branch satisfies it; the nonfixed branches exchange, giving Θ²=1; fixed points equal idempotents and nonfixed pairs are indexed by strictly increasing triples. Algebraic counts and reversal commutation follow by direct substitution. A standalone exact checker exhaustively verified all 7,820 rank-two maps for n=2..16, including both inverse equations and reversal equivariance; finite checks are not used as the general proof.

value.rationale: The 2026 full-moniod permutation matching prompts the stricter involution question. The rank-two class is a natural first nontrivial Green class; the uniform, explicit, idempotent-preserving, reversal-equivariant solution works in odd chain sizes beyond the 2024 divisible-incidence sufficient case, and gives a canonical three-point indexing of every nontrivial inverse pair. This is structural matching information rather than a routine numerical recomputation.
